decisions.topic: INT4 encoding, signed/unsigned tensor ranges, reserved codes and zero point
Weight/activation/K/V scale grouping, storage precision and static/dynamic generation
Rounding, clipping, all-zero, subnormal and invalid-scale behavior
Explicit tensor-by-tensor A4 coverage, including probability, residual, embedding and projection outputs
Explicit W4 parameter coverage, including embedding/lm_head sharing and normalization parameters
Accumulator width/order and RMSNorm, RoPE, Softmax, SiLU intermediate precision
Persistent GQA KV append/read, quantization placement relative to RoPE, scale identity and packing layout
Disjoint calibration/evaluation inputs and quality thresholds frozen before measurement
Software probe, model/agent calls and hardware build budgets before launch

verification_separation.quantization_quality: Compare the quantized software model against the original BF16 model on held-out inputs.
verification_separation.rtl_correctness: Compare RTL against the frozen quantized numerical reference; quality tolerances do not excuse implementation mismatches.
